digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge state / comment ID recording invariant
propositions: Successfully posted outbound Jira comments are not having their returned comment IDs recorded locally, causing comment_ids map to remain unchanged while post operations succeed
The invariant violation requires debounced detection across 2 consecutive reconcile passes rather than immediate per-pass firing to reduce false positives
The shared _record_comment_id seam in dispatch_apply_phases.py must tally every successful post independent of whether local ID recording succeeds
Cross-pass divergence state must be persisted in bridge_state/comment_id_divergence.json with fail-open behavior for corrupt or absent files
Alert firing on divergence should append a deduped bridge_alerts JSONL record naming the invariant and pass_id, with 24h dedup key
